title: Proposed Order
what_it_is: The draft order that rides with a motion, stating the specific relief the court is asked to sign. In Genesee, a proposed order and (per local practice) a concurrence certificate typically accompany a motion - the relief must be specific enough to enforce, not left to 'reasonable' or 'as agreed' language.
who_reads_it: The judge or referee who will sign (or decline to sign) it.
The opposing party, who reviews it for accuracy before any concurrence.
sequence: Draft the order in specific, enforceable terms - who does what, by when, and how it is measured.
Include any content a governing statute makes mandatory (e.g., the Hague Convention paragraph in a parenting-time order, MCL 722.27a(10)).
Attempt Genesee concurrence: send the proposed order and ask for agreement by a stated date (PROVISIONAL, confirm current LCR 2.119 practice).
File the proposed order with the motion (MCR 2.119(A)(1)(c)); sign the concurrence certificate honestly, reflecting the actual outcome of that attempt.
prepare: A checklist of every term: is it specific enough that a violation could be proved without argument?
Confirmation of any statutorily mandatory content for this type of order.

applicable_rules.summary: A motion must state the relief or order sought.
A parenting-time order may contain reasonable terms and conditions that facilitate the orderly and meaningful exercise of parenting time.

deadlines.label: Filed with the motion it accompanies

traps.trap: A term that says 'reasonable,' 'as agreed,' or 'as the parties arrange.'
traps.safe_move: Unenforceable - the FOC may decline to act on a violation of a non-specific term (MCL 552.641(2)(c)). Write a term that can be broken and proved broken.

traps.trap: Omitting mandatory statutory content for the type of order.
traps.safe_move: Check the governing statute; a parenting-time order has its own mandatory paragraph (MCL 722.27a(10)).

traps.trap: Signing a concurrence certificate that doesn't reflect what actually happened.
traps.safe_move: The certificate carries the full MCR 1.109(E) certification weight - sign it honestly.

do_not: Never characterize the other parent with a clinical label as a pleaded claim (narcissist, alienator, PAS, coercive control) - GUARDRAILS.md S2.
Never use the child as a witness, messenger, interviewee, or source, and never record the child - GUARDRAILS.md S8, absolute.
Never assert that any recording you made is lawful - Michigan law is unsettled and the exposure is criminal.
Never sign or stipulate to anything on the spot without reading it fully first.
Do not label the proposed order 'filing-ready' without your own final line-by-line read.

openers: Good morning/afternoon, Your Honor. My name is [Party], and I am representing myself.
I am here to address [narrow issue]. I have [N] exhibits and a short chronology.
closers: I don't have that information, but I can provide records if needed.
I'd like the record to reflect [narrow, factual point] and I reserve my right to address anything broader in the appropriate forum.

safety_gates: immediate danger -> 911, do not proceed on this guide alone
PPO/DV/CPS contact live -> stop, safety resources, do not proceed on this guide alone
UCCJEA/interstate fact -> stop, MC 416 affidavit guidance
recording question in any form -> unsettled law, criminal exposure, attorney question only
child asked/expected to speak to anyone about the case -> stop
exit_checklist: Every term is specific enough to enforce.
The concurrence attempt (if made) is documented with a date.
